title: The Courier
description: A courier in London discovers that one of the packages she's transporting is a bomb.

title: Legacy of Lies
description: A former MI6 agent teams up with a Ukrainian journalist to uncover the truth behind Russian covert operations.

title: MI-5: The Greater Good
description: A former MI5 agent (Peter Firth) investigates the disappearance of Harry Pearce (Kit Harington) when the operative is blamed for the escape of a ruthless terrorist (Elyes Gabel).

title: Jackie Brown
description: A bail bondsman (Robert Forster) helps a smuggler (Pam Grier) frame her boss (Samuel L. Jackson), an arms dealer who plans to kill her.

title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
description: A pregnant assassin, code-named The Bride, goes into a coma for four years after her ex-boss Bill brutally attacks her. When she wakes up, she sets out to seek revenge on him and his associates.

title: Kill Bill: Vol. 2
description: The Bride continues her quest of vengeance against her former boss and lover Bill, the reclusive bouncer Budd, and the treacherous, one-eyed Elle.

title: Inglourious Basterds
description: An Allied officer (Brad Pitt) and his team of Jewish soldiers join forces with a German actress and undercover agent to take down the leaders of the Third Reich.

title: Death Proof
description: Mike is a professional body double who uses his car to stalk and kill unsuspecting young women in the South.
